# Public DH test key

Synthetic OpenSSL 4.1.0 X9.42 SPKI using the RFC 5114 section 2.3 group
(2048-bit p, 256-bit q). The generation recipe and matching PKCS#8 containers
are in the CMS package's `tests/fixtures/dh` directory. This key is test data,
not a trust anchor or a mathematically validated group-generation transcript.
